name: Not My Tempo
kicker: Did you know? · Not My Tempo
cover:
Still letting go
of your guitar
to change tempo?

features.label: The usual way
features.headline:
Changing tempo
breaks your flow
features.text:
Let go, grab the phone, get back in position.
By then your practice has already stopped.

features.label: Just say it
features.headline:
Say faster.
It speeds up.
features.text:
Say start and it starts.
Say tempo 120 and you are at 120.

features.label: No setup
features.headline:
It listens
on your iPhone
features.text:
Understood on device.
No need to turn on Voice Control.

features.label: Forgot a command?
features.headline: Say help
features.text:
Everything you can say
shows up on screen.

outro:
Keep both hands
on your instrument
points: Tap tempo and a timing check
search: Search “Not My Tempo” on the App Store
